inputs.original_text: Eight million Americans join anti-Trump protests across US, organisers say An estimated 8 million people gathered at more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states, organisers of the “No Kings” protests said, as demonstrators voiced opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. News agency AFP reported that the events were held nationwide, though US authorities have not provided an official count. Organisers said turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations, noting there were “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.”
inputs.modified_text: They're trying to push this fake story claiming 8 million Americans showed up at these "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump, with more than 3,300 events in all 50 states. The organizers are claiming it's a million more people and 600 extra events over their October round, with AFP just parroting the numbers as if they're solid. Yet the US authorities released zero official count whatsoever. This is obviously the hidden elites and institutions coordinating behind the scenes to fabricate the illusion of massive resistance and protect their grip on everything. The total absence of any real verification exposes it as another manufactured narrative designed to weaken his position, not some authentic uprising.
